text: Who laid the foundations of the earth: Heb. he hath founded the earth upon her bases
They go up by the mountains: Or, The mountains ascend, the valleys descend
He sendeth: Heb. who sendeth | run: Heb. walk
oil to make his face to shine: Heb. to make his face shine with oil, or more then oil
all the beasts of the forest do creep forth: Heb. all the beasts thereof do trample on the forest
